title: Reasoning or Pattern Matching? Probing Large Vision–Language Models with Visual Puzzles
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating reasoning abilities (inductive, analogical, algorithmic, deductive, geometric/spatial) of LVLMs using visual puzzles and discusses limitations like brittle generalization, perception-reasoning entanglement, and explanation-execution gaps. It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a core component.
